ITA-9.1.31 bādhanam बाधनम्
Acute toxin
One of the two types of hazardous substance which produces an immediate harmful effect after use, e.g. poisoning, burning by fire or cutting with a sharp instrument.

ITA-5.64.4 bādhiryam बाधिर्यम्
Deafness
A disorder characterized by deafness/hearing impairment.
